_note: FROZEN pre-registration mirror (KTD9) for the ORB Production Ladder. Values are frozen against the head v30 backtest closed-trade distribution — see config/PREREGISTRATION.md for the per-value derivation and its backtest source. Amendable ONLY by an explicit re-registration dispatch. Every dispatch record cites the SHA-256 of this file. Rung tracking_bands are SCHEDULED: each rung's band freezes from the PRECEDING rung's LIVE data before the first session at that rung (KD3/KD6) — they are intentionally absent here (the backtest has zero slippage, so they cannot be grounded now). Rung 1 carries no tracking_band by design; a rung-2+ dispatch is fail-closed until its band is re-registered.
rung0_requalification: Re-entry to rung 1 requires ALL of: (1) the triggering limit event's root cause identified and written into the re-registration reason (elapsed time alone never qualifies — a benign-cause watchdog trip, KD5, still requires this); (2) at least 3 clean paper sessions run through the dispatch gate at LS_TRADING_ENV=paper since the suspension, each finalized with zero limit events; (3) attended operator re-registration with a fresh nonce.
